pages.title: Fewer liquids, further sight
pages.text:
Range is decided by how many **distinct** liquids are loaded, not by how full the tank is.

- **One**: 24 down, 18 sideways, 3x3.
- **Two**: 16 down, 12 sideways, 5x5.
- **Three or more**: 8 down, 6 sideways, 7x7.

pages.title: The trade
pages.text: A focused detector sees **deep and narrow**. A loaded one sees **wide and shallow**, and costs more liquid per click because it finds more.

pages.title: How many at once
pages.text: The tank holds five distinct ores at most. Pouring a bottle in fills whatever space is free and leaves the other charges alone, so a partial pour is allowed and still uses the whole bottle.
